python-syntax.description: Parse the candidate Python sources with the standard library only; this does not run project tests or prove behavior.
commands: import ast,pathlib; files=sorted(pathlib.Path('/workspace').rglob('*.py')); assert files, 'no Python files to validate'; [ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), filename=str(path)) for path in files]; print(f'parsed {len(files)} Python file(s)')
